On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]], [[Haxim]] was the ruler of a flourishing provincial '''kingdom'''. The [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the province had around 200,000 inhabitants. Several such kingdoms existed on Falleen. [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] hailed from this kingdom.
